description: This file defines the JmsService class, which models the <jms-service> element in the configuration. It includes properties like name, send mode, and a list of server configurations, providing accessors for each.

classes.name: JmsService
classes.description: A thread-safe class representing a JMS service configuration, encapsulating the service's name, send mode, and list of server configurations.

methods.name: JmsService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a JmsService object from an XML element, extracting attributes and child server elements.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the JMS service.

methods.name: getSendMode
methods.description: Returns the send mode configuration for the JMS service.

methods.name: getServers
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of Server objects associated with this JMS service.
